subject.title: [Feature]: Feature Request: Batch Tool Calls + Context Block Management + Plan Enforcement

question: Should OpenClaw keep this issue as one umbrella and split it into native tool batching, context block lifecycle, and plan/workflow enforcement tracks, and which of those belong in core runtime/API versus plugin or ClawHub surfaces?
rationale: The request adds native tool schemas, local context lifecycle semantics, new config/settings, and runner enforcement policy; repository policy treats these as compatibility- and product-sensitive choices rather than a narrow repair.

options.title: Split Into Design Tracks
options.body: Keep this issue open as the umbrella and require separate maintainer-reviewed designs for batching, context lifecycle, and plan enforcement before implementation.

options.title: Close In Favor Of Narrower Issues
options.body: Use the context and workflow issues as canonical for their portions and open or retain a separate batch-tools tracker if maintainers want independent tracking.

options.title: Reject Core Orchestration Expansion
options.body: Narrow or close the umbrella if maintainers decide AI-controlled context blocks and plan enforcement are too much heavy orchestration for core.

recommendation.title: Split Into Design Tracks
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the umbrella and require separate maintainer-reviewed designs for batching, context lifecycle, and plan enforcement before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest adjacent history across planning, strict-agentic execution, file/tool surfaces, and prior product-review comments on this issue.
